interpretation_note: Lazy can reduce scan/projection work, while aggregation state and key cardinality remain major bottlenecks.
Lazy is often expected to benefit most because the optimizer can view the whole query plan and avoid unnecessary intermediates.
Lazy can benefit from predicate/projection pushdown, but eager may be competitive when plan overhead dominates or output materialization is similar.
Eager can be competitive when lazy optimization overhead does not offset join materialization and key-handling costs.
